results.title: General Manager – Land Transportation
results.description: Our client, a growing land transportation company based in Najran, Saudi Arabia, is seeking an entrepreneurial and commercially driven General Manager to lead the business through its next stage of growth. The role requires a business builder with a strong track record of growing and scaling transportation or logistics businesses. The successful candidate will have full responsibility for the company's strategic, commercial, operational, and financial performance, with a strong mandate to accelerate business development, market penetration, expansion, and modernization . Key Responsibilities Develop and execute a multi-year growth and expansion strategy to significantly strengthen the company's market position. Drive business development and market penetration through new customers, contracts, sectors, services, and strategic partnerships. Identify and evaluate opportunities for geographic expansion, service diversification, and fleet investment. Take full ownership of the company's P&L, revenue growth, profitability, cash flow, and overall business performance. Lead large-scale transportation and fleet operations, ensuring strong asset utilization, productivity, service reliability, and cost efficiency. Optimize fleet performance, maintenance, fuel consumption, route planning, capacity utilization, and operational KPIs. Lead commercial negotiations, contract pricing, customer management, and strategic account development. Drive the company's digitalization and modernization agenda , leveraging technology, data, automation, and modern transport/fleet management systems. Build scalable organizational structures, processes, systems, and capabilities to support rapid business growth. Build and develop a strong leadership team and establish a performance-driven, accountable organizational culture. Maintain strong relationships with customers, strategic partners, government entities, and other key stakeholders. Ensure appropriate governance, safety, risk management, and regulatory compliance as the organization expands. Candidate Profile Minimum 12 years of relevant experience , including at least 5 years in a senior leadership capacity . Strong background within land transportation, logistics, fleet management, or a closely related sector . Proven track record of growing, scaling, or significantly expanding a business , with tangible achievements in revenue growth, market penetration, new customer acquisition, or business expansion. Strong business development and commercial orientation combined with solid transportation and fleet operational expertise. Demonstrated P&L ownership and strong understanding of profitability, cost structures, investment decisions, and asset utilization. Experience leading sizeable operational workforces and multidisciplinary teams. Exposure to digital transformation, fleet technology, automation, or transportation management systems is highly desirable. Entrepreneurial, hands-on, and highly results-oriented leadership style. Bachelor's degree in Business Administration, Engineering, Finance, Logistics, or a related discipline; an MBA is preferred. Interested candidates with a demonstrated record of building and scaling transportation businesses are invited to apply or share their profile for confidential consideration.

results.title: Director of Logistics
results.description: Logistics Director – Saudi Arabia A leading organisation is seeking an experienced Logistics Director to oversee and lead all logistics operations for a major, high-profile development project in Saudi Arabia. This is a senior, site-based leadership position responsible for developing and implementing the overall logistics strategy and ensuring the efficient movement of people, materials, equipment, vehicles, and resources across the project. The role will operate on a hybrid basis between Riyadh and the project site , with a strong site presence required to manage day-to-day logistics activities and coordinate closely with project leadership, contractors, consultants, and key stakeholders. Key Responsibilities Provide strategic leadership and overall direction for all project logistics and site logistics operations . Develop, implement, and continuously improve the project-wide logistics strategy, plans, procedures, and control systems . Oversee the movement, delivery, storage, and distribution of construction materials, plant, equipment, and other resources. Manage site access, traffic management, vehicle movements, laydown areas, storage facilities, delivery scheduling, and logistics compounds . Coordinate logistics requirements across multiple contractors, consultants, suppliers, and project teams to minimise disruption and maximise site efficiency. Establish effective systems for delivery management, material flow, site transportation, and resource allocation . Work closely with construction, engineering, procurement, commercial, HSE, security, and programme teams to ensure logistics activities align with overall project requirements. Monitor logistics performance, identify potential constraints and bottlenecks, and implement proactive solutions to maintain programme progress. Lead the planning and coordination of logistics requirements during different phases of construction and project development. Ensure all logistics activities comply with relevant HSE requirements, Saudi regulations, project standards, and operational procedures . Manage logistics-related risks, developing mitigation strategies and contingency plans where required. Provide regular reporting to senior project leadership on logistics performance, risks, constraints, resource requirements, and upcoming activities. Lead and develop logistics teams, promoting a strong culture of collaboration, accountability, safety, and continuous improvement. Liaise with local authorities, transport providers, suppliers, and other external stakeholders where required. Support the wider project leadership team in resolving complex logistical challenges and ensuring the project remains on programme. Candidate Profile The successful candidate will be a highly experienced Logistics Director / Senior Logistics Manager with a strong background in major construction, infrastructure, urban development, or mega-project environments. Experience managing logistics across large and complex sites, with multiple contractors and significant volumes of people, materials, and equipment, is highly desirable. The individual should demonstrate: Significant senior-level experience in construction and project logistics . Proven experience developing and implementing logistics strategies for large-scale projects. Strong understanding of site logistics, traffic management, material handling, access management, and supply-chain coordination . Excellent leadership and stakeholder-management capabilities. Strong commercial awareness and an ability to manage logistics efficiently within programme and budget constraints. Excellent communication, planning, problem-solving, and decision-making skills. The ability to operate confidently at both strategic and operational levels . Experience working in Saudi Arabia or the wider GCC would be advantageous. Location & Benefits This is a hybrid role , with the successful candidate working between Riyadh and the project site in Saudi Arabia . A regular and significant site presence will be required due to the operational nature of the position. When working on site, the package includes: Site allowance payable for time spent on site. Flights between Riyadh and the relevant site location. Hotel accommodation when required. Accommodation and transportation provided in connection with the site assignment. Opportunity to work on a major, high-profile development programme in Saudi Arabia.

results.title: Transportation Supervisor
results.description: About the Role We are looking for an experienced Transport Supervisor to oversee and coordinate daily transportation operations between the Distribution Center (DC) and assigned dark store locations across Kuwait . The role will be responsible for ensuring the timely and efficient movement of goods from the DC to dark stores, managing delivery routes and schedules, overseeing truck fleet operations and utilization , monitoring driver performance, and maintaining high standards of operational efficiency and service quality. The Transport Supervisor will also be responsible for route planning and optimization, delivery allocation, truck fleet management, vehicle utilization and availability, driver coordination, transportation performance tracking, and managing operational issues and delays . The role will work closely with DC and dark store teams to ensure smooth and reliable replenishment operations, minimize delivery delays, optimize transportation resources, and ensure that dark stores receive the required inventory on time. Key Responsibilities Manage daily transportation operations from the Distribution Center (DC) to assigned dark store locations , ensuring timely, safe, and efficient movement of goods and smooth execution of replenishment plans. Plan, coordinate, and optimize transport routes, delivery schedules, truck allocation, and delivery capacity based on business requirements, store demand, and operational priorities. Manage and monitor the truck fleet , including vehicle availability, utilization, deployment, maintenance coordination, and overall fleet efficiency. Coordinate and supervise drivers and transport teams , ensuring adherence to delivery schedules, assigned routes, operational procedures, safety requirements, and service standards. Monitor daily transportation performance and key KPIs, including on-time delivery, route efficiency, vehicle utilization, delivery turnaround time, transportation costs, and service quality . Track deliveries in real time, identify delays, route deviations, vehicle issues, and other transportation exceptions, and take timely corrective actions to minimize operational disruptions. Coordinate closely with DC, dark store, warehouse, operations, and other relevant teams to ensure accurate loading, dispatch, receiving, and timely replenishment of dark stores. Identify, investigate, and resolve transportation-related operational issues and delivery exceptions, conducting root-cause analysis and implementing corrective and preventive actions. Analyze transportation data and operational trends to identify opportunities for route optimization, fleet utilization, cost reduction, and process improvement . Ensure compliance with company transportation policies, fleet safety standards, vehicle requirements, driver procedures, and applicable local regulations . Oversee the training and development of drivers and transport team members, ensuring they have the required operational knowledge, safety awareness, and service standards. Prepare regular transportation performance reports and provide data-driven insights and recommendations to management on fleet performance, route efficiency, operational issues, and improvement opportunities. Support the development and continuous optimization of transportation processes, route planning, fleet management, and DC-to-dark-store delivery operations to improve efficiency, reliability, and overall service quality. Job Requirements Bachelor's degree or higher in Logistics, Supply Chain Management, Business Administration , or a related field; alternatively, 3+ years of relevant experience in transport, logistics, or delivery operations . Proven experience in delivery, transport, logistics, fleet, preferably within a fast-paced e-commerce or delivery environment. Strong communication, coordination, and stakeholder management skills, with the ability to work effectively across multiple teams. Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with the ability to interpret operational data and identify performance improvement opportunities. Strong execution and follow-up skills, with the ability to work effectively under pressure in a fast-paced environment. Good project management and process improvement capabilities. Fluent in English , with strong written and verbal communication skills. Willingness to be based in Kuwait and work according to operational requirements, including flexible working hours when necessary.

results.title: Sr. Manager Logistics Operations
results.description: Talabat is part of the Delivery Hero Group, the world’s pioneering local delivery platform, our mission is to deliver an amazing experience—fast, easy, and to your door. We operate in around 65 countries worldwide. Headquartered in Berlin, Germany. Delivery Hero has been listed on the Frankfurt Stock Exchange since 2017 and is part of the MDAX stock market index. Job Description WHAT’S ON YOUR PLATE? Lead Talabat Qatar’s overall supply ecosystem, ensuring a sustainable, high-quality, and high-performing rider base across the country. Develop and execute the overall supply growth and acquisition strategy aligned with business demand and market dynamics. Lead long-term supply forecasting and planning to ensure full coverage and service level adherence. Identify and launch new supply channels such as female riders, refugees, micro-financing, and e-bikes to diversify and sustain fleet growth. Manage the full lifecycle of 3PL partnerships, from selection and onboarding to performance management and contract renewals. Set clear KPIs and SLAs for 3PL partners, ensuring compliance, efficiency, and rider quality. Build and maintain strong strategic relationships with key 3PL partners to drive alignment and operational excellence. Lead and manage the on-ground operations team to ensure smooth daily operations, compliance, and service quality. Monitor and improve key operational KPIs including rider supply rate, EPH, order-on-time percentage, and churn rate. Implement standardized processes and digital tools to enhance control, visibility, and scalability across operations. Coach and develop a high-performing team of managers, seniors, and specialists across supply, 3PLs, and operations. Foster a culture of accountability, collaboration, and continuous improvement within the team. Work closely with cross-functional teams such as People, Finance, Commercial, and Product to align on strategies and deliverables. Identify and implement process improvements and best practices to enhance efficiency and rider satisfaction. Drive automation and technology-enabled initiatives to improve visibility and performance management. Oversee equipment management including uniforms, delivery boxes, and e-bikes to ensure consistent quality and operational standards. Ensure adherence to performance KPIs such as supply run rate, rider churn and retention, 3PL compliance, rider NPS, EPH, and operational coverage. Build long-term plans to sustain growth and strengthen Talabat’s market leadership position. Qualifications WHAT DID WE ORDER? Bachelor’s degree required, with a preference for majors in Logistics, Supply Chain, Operations, or equivalent work experience in compliance or auditing Minimum of 5 years of experience in operational roles within fast-paced environments. Track record in the FoodTech logistics sector is a plus. Management consulting experience is also considered a significant advantage Management experience is advantageous, with the ability to effectively manage direct reports and foster a strong team culture. Strong problem-solving abilities, with the capacity to dig into detail, manage complexity, and drive decision-making Advanced proficiency in GSheet, demonstrating a strong analytical skill set. Ability to reason analytically, logically, and in a consistent fashion Strong English written and verbal communication skills, capable of engaging across a diverse set of stakeholders, Arabic is good to have but not necessary Extremely organized and process-driven, with a proven ability to manage a heavy workload effectively by setting priorities and managing expectations well Able to travel to all talabat markets as needed.

results.title: Director of Operations - Saudi Arabia AOC (GACA)
results.description: Beond is the world's first premium leisure airline, flying an all-lie-flat Airbus fleet, and is standing up new Air Operator Certificates in Bahrain (BCAA) and Saudi Arabia (GACA). We are seeking a Director of Operations for our Saudi Arabia AOC (General Authority of Civil Aviation), based in Riyadh, Saudi Arabia. The Director of Operations is appointed by, and reports to, the Accountable Executive, and is responsible for: Exercise operational control and accountability for the conduct of flight operations under the AOC Own the operations manual, ensure ops-specifications compliance and set operational standards Oversee flight dispatch, flight-time limitations and flight-crew standards Serve as the operational interface with GACA for approvals, audits and findings Embed the SMS within operations Requirements This is a required management position under GACAR Part 121.45. The post is full-time and the successful candidate must be acceptable to GACA (the President) based on experience, competence and knowledge, with a full understanding of the GACAR, the operations specifications, applicable airworthiness requirements and the operations manual (GACAR 121.45(e), (g)). Mandatory Hold an Airline Transport Pilot (ATP) certificate (GACAR 121.49(a)(1)) At least 3 years' supervisory/managerial experience within the last 6 years exercising operational control over Part 121-similar operations (GACAR 121.49(a)(2)) At least 3 years' experience within the past 6 years as PIC of a Part 121 aircraft — for a first-time Director of Operations (GACAR 121.49(a)(3)) Full understanding of the GACAR, the operations specifications, applicable airworthiness requirements and the operations manual; must be acceptable to GACA (GACAR 121.45(e), (g)) Desirable Airbus A320/A321 experience Existing GACA regulatory relationships and new-AOC experience Fluent English; Arabic advantageous Benefits A competitive package with relocation support where applicable, and the opportunity to build a premium airline certificate from the ground up as part of a fast-growing multi-AOC group. If you do not receive a response from us within 4 weeks of submitting your application, please consider your application to be unsuccessful due to the high volume of applications we receive.

results.title: Head of Logistics Asset Management - Industrial Real Estate Development & Investments
results.description: Head of Asset Management (Logistics & Industrial Development) Riyadh, Saudi Arabia We are partnering with a leading industrial real estate investment and development platform that is expanding its presence in Saudi Arabia. The business develops, owns and operates industrial parks, logistics warehouses and built-to-suit facilities, with a long-term ownership strategy focused on creating high-quality logistics assets. As part of its continued growth, the firm is seeking a Head of Logistics to lead its logistics warehouse platform across the Kingdom. Key Responsibilities: Define the logistics warehouse product strategy based on market demand and customer requirements. Partner with development and engineering teams to ensure assets meet commercial and leasing requirements. Monitor market trends, rental levels, supply dynamics and customer demand to support business strategy. Develop relationships with logistics operators, 3PLs, e-commerce businesses, retailers and brokerage networks. Drive leasing activity, occupancy and rental income across the portfolio. Originate and negotiate build-to-suit opportunities and pre-leasing agreements with key occupiers. Lead lease negotiations, including commercial terms, incentives and renewals. Oversee asset performance, including occupancy, NOI, budgets and long-term value creation. Manage external property management and facilities management providers to maintain operational excellence. Build and lead the logistics asset management, leasing and customer development team as the business grows. Requirements: Bachelor's degree in Real Estate, Business, Finance or a related discipline. 8+ years' experience within logistics or industrial real estate. Strong background across leasing, customer development and asset management. Deep understanding of logistics warehouse products and what drives successful leasing performance. Established network within the Saudi logistics market, including 3PLs, e-commerce operators, retailers and industry stakeholders. Excellent commercial negotiation and relationship management skills. Experience leading or mentoring teams. Fluent in both Arabic and English.

results.title: Executive Director – Logistics
results.description: We are seeking an experienced Executive Director – Logistics to lead and grow its logistics business. The role will have broad responsibility for business strategy, commercial performance, operations, customer development and team leadership. Requirements: Bachelor's degree required; postgraduate qualification preferred. 15 years of experience in logistics, freight forwarding or a related industry. At least 5 years in a senior leadership role with significant commercial and P&L responsibility. Proven track record of building, transforming or scaling a logistics business. Strong commercial background with experience in business development, customer acquisition and strategic partnerships. Broad knowledge of freight and logistics operations, ideally across multiple modes and markets. Demonstrated ability to deliver revenue, profitability and growth targets. Experience leading and developing large, multicultural teams. Strong strategic thinking, commercial acumen and execution capability. Excellent negotiation, stakeholder management and communication skills. Entrepreneurial mindset with the ability to operate effectively in a growth and transformation environment. Fluent English required; Arabic is an advantage. Key Responsibilities: Develop and execute the business strategy and growth plan for the logistics business. Lead commercial development across key markets, customers and industry sectors. Build and manage strategic relationships with customers, logistics partners, carriers and other key stakeholders. Drive revenue, profitability, customer growth and overall P&L performance. Develop and optimize logistics products and solutions across relevant modes and services. Establish efficient operational processes, service standards and performance KPIs. Identify new market, customer and partnership opportunities to accelerate growth. Lead the development of a high-performing organization, including recruitment, capability building and succession planning. Ensure strong governance across compliance, risk, quality, safety and operational performance. Drive the use of technology and digital solutions to improve efficiency and customer experience. Represent the organization with key customers, partners, regulators and industry stakeholders. Work closely with senior leadership and corporate functions to deliver strategic objectives.

results.title: Senior Operations Manager - Dry Bulk Shipping
results.description: WE ARE HIRING | SENIOR OPERATIONS MANAGER | DUBAI, UAE OBE SHIPS MANAGEMENT CO. LLC is looking for an experienced and commercially minded Senior Operations Manager of Dry Bulk Fleet to join our team in Dubai. This is a hands-on post-fixture operations role for someone who understands that successful vessel operations are not just about following a voyage they are about protecting the Company’s interests, controlling costs, solving problems quickly and ensuring each voyage performs efficiently. ⚓ THE ROLE The successful candidate will manage assigned dry bulk vessels from fixture through voyage completion , including: • Voyage planning, cargo intake, bunker planning and port considerations • Issuing voyage instructions and coordinating with Masters, Charterers, Owners, agents, brokers and surveyors • Monitoring vessel schedules, cargo readiness, port congestion, berthing and weather • Coordinating loading/discharging operations and reviewing stowage plans • Monitoring speed, consumption, bunkers and overall voyage performance • Controlling voyage expenses and disbursements • Handling Bills of Lading, NORs, SOFs, BDNs and other operational documentation • Laytime/demurrage calculations, freight/hire statements and voyage accounts • Handling operational claims, Charter Party disputes and performance matters • Coordinating with P&I Clubs, insurers and surveyors when required • Following up outstanding freight, hire, demurrage and other receivables 🎯 WHAT WE ARE LOOKING FOR • Minimum 5+ years of hands-on dry bulk vessel operations experience • Strong knowledge of Charter Parties, post-fixture operations, laytime and demurrage • Good understanding of dry bulk cargoes, stowage, ports, bunkering and vessel documentation • Strong commercial awareness and cost-control mindset • Experience with claims and P&I matters is an advantage • Strong analytical, numerical and problem-solving skills • Ability to manage multiple vessels and voyages simultaneously • Excellent written and spoken English • Strong Excel/MS Office skills; Veson IMOS and Shipfix experience is an advantage 💡 THE PERSON We are looking for a proactive operator who takes ownership — someone who does not simply pass problems on, but understands the issue, assesses its operational and commercial implications and finds practical solutions that protect the Company’s interests. 📍 Location: Dubai, UAE 🏢 Company: OBE SHIPS MANAGEMENT CO. LLC 📩 Interested candidates are invited to apply through LinkedIn or send their CV through the contact details provided. #OBESHIPS #Hiring #DryBulk #DryBulkShipping #Shipping #Maritime #VesselOperator #ShipOperations #PostFixture #ShippingJobs #DubaiJobs #MaritimeJobs
